groups.meta: ~250,000 standing across 5 rank-ups plus the blueprint

rows.label: rank-ups to Old Mate
rows.note: Rank 5; 5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000 per rank, plus Debt-Bonds and 385,000 credits

conditions: The daily cap is 16,000 standing plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across the faction syndicates, so Rank 5 is a multi-day gate however well you farm.
The Vulcax needs Mastery Rank 14 to equip.
bonuses: Conservation is the consensus fastest cap: tranquilize a Kubrodon with a sleep or invisibility frame (Equinox, Ivara) and its Echo-Lure for roughly 4,000 or 8,000 standing a capture. Mining is a close second.
Rank 5 is usually reached anyway for Necramech parts and the Cryotra, Tazicor and Helstrum on the same shelf.

rows.label: Training, Shelter, Medical, Advances and Familial Debt-Bonds

bonuses: Eudico and Solaris United Agent bounties are the usual Rank 5 route.

conditions: The free Rank 5 item from the standing vendors may cover this, if the blueprint is eligible.

groups.activity: mine blue veins, refine at Old Man Suumbaat
conditions: Needs Old Man Suumbaat's refining blueprint: 5,000 Ostron standing at Ostron rank 2 (Visitor). The step people forget.

groups.activity: mine Goblite, fish Kriller and Tromyzon, dismantle at The Business

rows.label: Goblite Tears
rows.note: refined from 10 Goblite, blue veins; Smokefinger blueprint, 2,000 standing at Solaris rank 1

rows.label: Kriller Thermal Laser
rows.note: 1 per Kriller, lakes in warm weather; Kriller Bait is 100 standing at Outworlder
rows.alt: also drops from breaking Vallis containers

rows.label: Tromyzon Entroplasma
rows.note: 1 per Tromyzon, cold-weather ponds; Tromyzon Bait is 300 standing at Doer
rows.alt: or one Exploiter Orb kill, 7-8 per loot

conditions: Kriller spawns only in the warm window, about 4 minutes of a 26-minute cycle. Mine or fish Tromyzon while you wait.
Use Shockprod or Stunna spears so the fish are not damaged.
bonuses: The Exploiter Orb drops the Entroplasma and plenty of gems in one fight.
A Resourceful Retriever companion and large Fortuna cave veins speed the mining.
Levels from the companion's kills on a MOA or Sentinel; robotic weapons share mod slots with your equipped weapon.
